name: Filamentous Fiber Packing Density
definition: The degree of space filling by elongated, cylindrical fibrous or wire-like structural elements within the field of view.
description: The degree of space filling by elongated, cylindrical fibrous or wire-like structural elements within the field of view.
scale_1: Entirely absent; no continuous elongated fibers or bundles are present in the microstructure.
scale_5: Moderate presence of fibers or wire bundles loosely organized with noticeable void spacing between bundles.
scale_10: Microstructure is completely dominated by tightly interwoven bundles of continuous, high-aspect-ratio fibers with minimal open space.
scoring_guide: 1: Entirely absent; no continuous elongated fibers or bundles are present in the microstructure.; 5: Moderate presence of fibers or wire bundles loosely organized with noticeable void spacing between bundles.; 10: Microstructure is completely dominated by tightly interwoven bundles of continuous, high-aspect-ratio fibers with minimal open space.

name: Periodic Array Regularity
definition: The degree to which discrete morphological features are arranged in a repeating, highly ordered geometric 1D or 2D grid.
description: The degree to which discrete morphological features are arranged in a repeating, highly ordered geometric 1D or 2D grid.
scale_1: Complete absence of translational periodicity or repeating grid patterns; features are randomly distributed or featureless.
scale_5: Partial or localized periodicity, such as a localized linear grating or patch of repeating units occupying only a portion of the field of view.
scale_10: Global, highly uniform two-dimensional repeating array tiling across the entire field of view with strict translational symmetry.
scoring_guide: 1: Complete absence of translational periodicity or repeating grid patterns; features are randomly distributed or featureless.; 5: Partial or localized periodicity, such as a localized linear grating or patch of repeating units occupying only a portion of the field of view.; 10: Global, highly uniform two-dimensional repeating array tiling across the entire field of view with strict translational symmetry.

name: Topographical Relief and Edge Contrast Prominence
definition: The magnitude of out-of-plane vertical stepping, trench depth, and associated secondary electron edge emission brightness along sharp structural boundaries.
description: The magnitude of out-of-plane vertical stepping, trench depth, and associated secondary electron edge emission brightness along sharp structural boundaries.
scale_1: Planar and flush morphology lacking vertical steps, recessed boundaries, or bright secondary electron edge fringes.
scale_5: Moderate three-dimensional relief with visible shallow trenches and well-defined, distinct bright edge emission lines along contours.
scale_10: Pronounced vertical relief exhibiting deep shadowed interstitial voids and intensely bright, blooming emission rims along tall projecting features.
scoring_guide: 1: Planar and flush morphology lacking vertical steps, recessed boundaries, or bright secondary electron edge fringes.; 5: Moderate three-dimensional relief with visible shallow trenches and well-defined, distinct bright edge emission lines along contours.; 10: Pronounced vertical relief exhibiting deep shadowed interstitial voids and intensely bright, blooming emission rims along tall projecting features.

name: Microstructural Grain Contrast Patchiness
definition: The presence of planar, multi-tonal gray-level patches corresponding to orientation contrast or multi-phase planar domain mosaics.
description: The presence of planar, multi-tonal gray-level patches corresponding to orientation contrast or multi-phase planar domain mosaics.
scale_1: Uniform, homogeneous gray tone across the background matrix with no visible grain-to-grain channeling or orientation contrast.
scale_5: Faint or localized contrast variations with subtle boundary demarcations across some regions of the matrix.
scale_10: Pervasive, continuous mosaic of contrasting light and dark planar domains covering the entire viewing area.
scoring_guide: 1: Uniform, homogeneous gray tone across the background matrix with no visible grain-to-grain channeling or orientation contrast.; 5: Faint or localized contrast variations with subtle boundary demarcations across some regions of the matrix.; 10: Pervasive, continuous mosaic of contrasting light and dark planar domains covering the entire viewing area.

name: Directional Alignment of Elongated Structures
definition: The degree of mutual parallel orientation exhibited by elongated microstructural elements such as columns, fibers, or striations.
description: The degree of mutual parallel orientation exhibited by elongated microstructural elements such as columns, fibers, or striations.
scale_1: Completely isotropic or equiaxed features with no discernible preferred orientation axis.
scale_5: Partially oriented features showing a moderate preferred direction with frequent local misalignments.
scale_10: Strictly parallel alignment of elongated structures uniformly spanning the entire field of view.
scoring_guide: 1: Completely isotropic or equiaxed features with no discernible preferred orientation axis.; 5: Partially oriented features showing a moderate preferred direction with frequent local misalignments.; 10: Strictly parallel alignment of elongated structures uniformly spanning the entire field of view.

name: Planar Boundary and Facet Edge Sharpness
definition: The visual distinctness, contrast, and angular sharpness of lines or intersections delineating planar surfaces or macroscopic structural facets.
description: The visual distinctness, contrast, and angular sharpness of lines or intersections delineating planar surfaces or macroscopic structural facets.
scale_1: Entirely absent; surfaces are curved, rounded, or uniformly textured without visible planar boundaries or angular facet edges.
scale_5: Moderately defined planar boundaries or softly rounded facet junctions with moderate edge contrast and partial continuity.
scale_10: Crisp, razor-sharp, high-contrast linear boundaries and acute intersections defining prominent geometric planar facets.
scoring_guide: 1: Entirely absent; surfaces are curved, rounded, or uniformly textured without visible planar boundaries or angular facet edges.; 5: Moderately defined planar boundaries or softly rounded facet junctions with moderate edge contrast and partial continuity.; 10: Crisp, razor-sharp, high-contrast linear boundaries and acute intersections defining prominent geometric planar facets.

name: Aspect Ratio of Primary Microstructural Units
definition: The ratio of the longest dimension to the shortest orthogonal dimension of the primary identifiable individual structural units.
description: The ratio of the longest dimension to the shortest orthogonal dimension of the primary identifiable individual structural units.
scale_1: Equiaxed units with roughly circular, polygonal, or square shapes having an aspect ratio near 1:1.
scale_5: Moderately elongated units such as short columns or oblong nodules with aspect ratios around 2:1 to 4:1.
scale_10: Extremely elongated, continuous longitudinal fibers or pillars with aspect ratios exceeding 10:1.
scoring_guide: 1: Equiaxed units with roughly circular, polygonal, or square shapes having an aspect ratio near 1:1.; 5: Moderately elongated units such as short columns or oblong nodules with aspect ratios around 2:1 to 4:1.; 10: Extremely elongated, continuous longitudinal fibers or pillars with aspect ratios exceeding 10:1.

name: Discrete Particle Spatial Areal Density
definition: The number concentration of isolated, detached small particulate units per unit field-of-view area across the substrate.
description: The number concentration of isolated, detached small particulate units per unit field-of-view area across the substrate.
scale_1: Entirely absent or continuous bulk phase with zero isolated individual particulate units visible
scale_5: Sparse to moderate scattering of separated particulate units occupying a minor fraction of the visual field
scale_10: High spatial concentration of separate particulate entities distributed ubiquitously across the entire field of view
scoring_guide: 1: Entirely absent or continuous bulk phase with zero isolated individual particulate units visible; 5: Sparse to moderate scattering of separated particulate units occupying a minor fraction of the visual field; 10: High spatial concentration of separate particulate entities distributed ubiquitously across the entire field of view

name: Sub-Micron Surface Grain Roughness
definition: The textural coarseness and presence of fine sub-micron granular or nodular asperities covering the primary structural facets.
description: The textural coarseness and presence of fine sub-micron granular or nodular asperities covering the primary structural facets.
scale_1: Completely smooth, mirror-like facet surfaces without any visible nanoscale or sub-micron nodular roughness
scale_5: Lightly stippled surface displaying faint, scattered micro-nodules or shallow textural rugosity
scale_10: Extremely coarse, densely cauliflower-like or granular mantle of fine sub-micron asperities covering all surfaces
scoring_guide: 1: Completely smooth, mirror-like facet surfaces without any visible nanoscale or sub-micron nodular roughness; 5: Lightly stippled surface displaying faint, scattered micro-nodules or shallow textural rugosity; 10: Extremely coarse, densely cauliflower-like or granular mantle of fine sub-micron asperities covering all surfaces

name: Depth-of-Field Focal Degradation
definition: The extent to which features situated away from the primary focal plane exhibit optical blur and loss of high-frequency edge definition.
description: The extent to which features situated away from the primary focal plane exhibit optical blur and loss of high-frequency edge definition.
scale_1: Uniformly crisp high-frequency sharpness maintained across all visible structures in the image frame
scale_5: Noticeable soft-focus blur affecting deeply recessed or distant background structures while foreground remains sharp
scale_10: Severe, diffuse focal defocusing obscuring fine morphology across large portions of the field of view outside a narrow focal zone
scoring_guide: 1: Uniformly crisp high-frequency sharpness maintained across all visible structures in the image frame; 5: Noticeable soft-focus blur affecting deeply recessed or distant background structures while foreground remains sharp; 10: Severe, diffuse focal defocusing obscuring fine morphology across large portions of the field of view outside a narrow focal zone

name: Structural Branching Junction Density
definition: The frequency of multi-arm interconnected node intersections and branch-points per unit area within skeletal or filamentous networks.
description: The frequency of multi-arm interconnected node intersections and branch-points per unit area within skeletal or filamentous networks.
scale_1: Absence of branched nodal intersections, consisting entirely of unbranched segments, isolated points, or bulk continuous mass
scale_5: Occasional nodal connections and y-junctions linking segments into a loosely connected meshwork
scale_10: Profuse, highly interconnected multiaxial nodal network dominated by dense, interlocking star-like junction points
scoring_guide: 1: Absence of branched nodal intersections, consisting entirely of unbranched segments, isolated points, or bulk continuous mass; 5: Occasional nodal connections and y-junctions linking segments into a loosely connected meshwork; 10: Profuse, highly interconnected multiaxial nodal network dominated by dense, interlocking star-like junction points

name: Geometric Angularity of Protruding Features
definition: The degree to which elevated surface microstructures exhibit sharp, planar-faceted, and acute pyramidal apexes rather than smoothly curved or hemispherical contours.
description: The degree to which elevated surface microstructures exhibit sharp, planar-faceted, and acute pyramidal apexes rather than smoothly curved or hemispherical contours.
scale_1: Features are entirely smooth, spherical, or softly rounded with no planar facets or sharp apexes.
scale_5: Features exhibit a mix of rounded curvatures and defined edges or moderate polygonal facets.
scale_10: Features terminate in exceptionally sharp, acute needle-like points or crisp, planar polyhedral facets.
scoring_guide: 1: Features are entirely smooth, spherical, or softly rounded with no planar facets or sharp apexes.; 5: Features exhibit a mix of rounded curvatures and defined edges or moderate polygonal facets.; 10: Features terminate in exceptionally sharp, acute needle-like points or crisp, planar polyhedral facets.

name: Curvilinear Tortuosity of Filamentous Strands
definition: The degree of bending, looping, and structural curvature exhibited by individual continuous wire or fiber segments relative to straight linear paths.
description: The degree of bending, looping, and structural curvature exhibited by individual continuous wire or fiber segments relative to straight linear paths.
scale_1: Elements are completely straight and linear with zero detectable bending or curvature.
scale_5: Elements exhibit gentle, moderate arc curvatures with large radii of curvature.
scale_10: Elements are intensely curved, looped, curled, and twisted into tight helical or winding loops.
scoring_guide: 1: Elements are completely straight and linear with zero detectable bending or curvature.; 5: Elements exhibit gentle, moderate arc curvatures with large radii of curvature.; 10: Elements are intensely curved, looped, curled, and twisted into tight helical or winding loops.

name: Sub-Micron Surface Granular Stippling Density
definition: The areal density of tiny, fine particulate precipitates or nodular granular stippling uniformly speckling the substrate or background plane.
description: The areal density of tiny, fine particulate precipitates or nodular granular stippling uniformly speckling the substrate or background plane.
scale_1: Background substrate is uniformly featureless, specular, or completely flat without particulate stippling.
scale_5: Substrate displays a scattered, moderate coverage of faint nano-nodules or stippled surface asperities.
scale_10: Substrate is densely and continuously textured with an unbroken carpet of fine granular asperities and nodular stippling.
scoring_guide: 1: Background substrate is uniformly featureless, specular, or completely flat without particulate stippling.; 5: Substrate displays a scattered, moderate coverage of faint nano-nodules or stippled surface asperities.; 10: Substrate is densely and continuously textured with an unbroken carpet of fine granular asperities and nodular stippling.

name: Inter-Unit Gap Discontinuity
definition: The prominence and frequency of empty interstitial gaps interrupting contiguous linearly chained microstructural elements.
description: The prominence and frequency of empty interstitial gaps interrupting contiguous linearly chained microstructural elements.
scale_1: No interstitial gaps visible; elements form unbroken, continuous contiguous lines or uniform solid structures.
scale_5: Periodic narrow voids or periodic necking gaps moderately segmenting linear features into identifiable units.
scale_10: Frequent, well-defined open transverse gaps clearly separating linear sequences into completely discrete detached blocks or beads.
scoring_guide: 1: No interstitial gaps visible; elements form unbroken, continuous contiguous lines or uniform solid structures.; 5: Periodic narrow voids or periodic necking gaps moderately segmenting linear features into identifiable units.; 10: Frequent, well-defined open transverse gaps clearly separating linear sequences into completely discrete detached blocks or beads.

name: Concentric Curvature Gradient
definition: The degree to which curvilinear features exhibit a systematic nesting of nested concentric rings with monotonically increasing radii of curvature.
description: The degree to which curvilinear features exhibit a systematic nesting of nested concentric rings with monotonically increasing radii of curvature.
scale_1: Completely absent; features are straight, random, or entangled without any nested concentric circular or elliptical arcs.
scale_5: Moderate presence of curved nested features showing partial concentric arc segments over a localized portion of the field of view.
scale_10: Dominant, highly ordered concentric ring morphology centered across the frame with smoothly expanding radial curvature.
scoring_guide: 1: Completely absent; features are straight, random, or entangled without any nested concentric circular or elliptical arcs.; 5: Moderate presence of curved nested features showing partial concentric arc segments over a localized portion of the field of view.; 10: Dominant, highly ordered concentric ring morphology centered across the frame with smoothly expanding radial curvature.

name: Inter-Bundle Void Volume Fraction
definition: The areal fraction of deep black interstitial shadowed void space visible between macroscopic bundles or clusters of features.
description: The areal fraction of deep black interstitial shadowed void space visible between macroscopic bundles or clusters of features.
scale_1: Virtually zero interstitial void; the field is entirely filled by a solid, continuous, or tightly packed surface.
scale_5: Moderate open void spaces occupy roughly a quarter to half of the visible area between separated feature groupings.
scale_10: Extremely high void fraction; massive continuous empty dark vacuum regions dominate the background with sparse, isolated foreground structures.
scoring_guide: 1: Virtually zero interstitial void; the field is entirely filled by a solid, continuous, or tightly packed surface.; 5: Moderate open void spaces occupy roughly a quarter to half of the visible area between separated feature groupings.; 10: Extremely high void fraction; massive continuous empty dark vacuum regions dominate the background with sparse, isolated foreground structures.

name: Collimated Bundle Cohesion
definition: The degree to which adjacent individual filamentous strands remain tightly bundled into coherent macroscopic rope-like clusters rather than splaying into isolated strands.
description: The degree to which adjacent individual filamentous strands remain tightly bundled into coherent macroscopic rope-like clusters rather than splaying into isolated strands.
scale_1: No bundling; filaments are completely isolated, detached single strands, or the structure is entirely non-filamentous.
scale_5: Filaments show partial loose clustering into identifiable strands with frequent fraying and lateral detachment.
scale_10: Filaments are packed into dense, coherent, neatly gathered multi-fiber yarn or rope bundles with minimal stray individual fibers.
scoring_guide: 1: No bundling; filaments are completely isolated, detached single strands, or the structure is entirely non-filamentous.; 5: Filaments show partial loose clustering into identifiable strands with frequent fraying and lateral detachment.; 10: Filaments are packed into dense, coherent, neatly gathered multi-fiber yarn or rope bundles with minimal stray individual fibers.

name: Dispersed Phase Cluster Aggregation Degree
definition: The degree to which discrete particulate inclusions aggregate into multi-particle clusters rather than remaining isolated singlets.
description: The degree to which discrete particulate inclusions aggregate into multi-particle clusters rather than remaining isolated singlets.
scale_1: Virtually all visible particles appear as isolated singlets with negligible direct particle-particle contact.
scale_5: A moderate mix of isolated individual particles and small multiplet clusters containing 2 to 5 contacting particles.
scale_10: Particles predominantly aggregate into extensive, dense multi-particle clusters and agglomerate colonies.
scoring_guide: 1: Virtually all visible particles appear as isolated singlets with negligible direct particle-particle contact.; 5: A moderate mix of isolated individual particles and small multiplet clusters containing 2 to 5 contacting particles.; 10: Particles predominantly aggregate into extensive, dense multi-particle clusters and agglomerate colonies.

name: Transverse Filament Diameter Monodispersity
definition: The degree of cross-sectional thickness uniformity across visible fibrous or columnar microstructural elements.
description: The degree of cross-sectional thickness uniformity across visible fibrous or columnar microstructural elements.
scale_1: High diameter polydispersity with pronounced thickness variations, taperings, or multi-modal fiber widths.
scale_5: Moderate cross-sectional uniformity with noticeable minor variations in filament or column thickness.
scale_10: Strictly monodisperse filaments exhibiting virtually identical, highly uniform transverse diameters throughout.
scoring_guide: 1: High diameter polydispersity with pronounced thickness variations, taperings, or multi-modal fiber widths.; 5: Moderate cross-sectional uniformity with noticeable minor variations in filament or column thickness.; 10: Strictly monodisperse filaments exhibiting virtually identical, highly uniform transverse diameters throughout.

name: Hexagonal Close-Packing Coordination
definition: The visual prevalence of six-fold hexagonal nearest-neighbor coordination in quasi-periodic or packed particulate arrays.
description: The visual prevalence of six-fold hexagonal nearest-neighbor coordination in quasi-periodic or packed particulate arrays.
scale_1: No six-fold or hexagonal nearest-neighbor arrangement; distribution is completely random, amorphous, or purely uncoordinated.
scale_5: Localized patches of hexagonal or six-fold coordination surrounded by disordered or imperfectly packed regions.
scale_10: Nearly ubiquitous, highly ordered hexagonal close-packing with consistent six-fold coordination across the visible array.
scoring_guide: 1: No six-fold or hexagonal nearest-neighbor arrangement; distribution is completely random, amorphous, or purely uncoordinated.; 5: Localized patches of hexagonal or six-fold coordination surrounded by disordered or imperfectly packed regions.; 10: Nearly ubiquitous, highly ordered hexagonal close-packing with consistent six-fold coordination across the visible array.

name: Free-Standing Fiber End Density
definition: The areal density of exposed, broken, or terminated fiber tips visibly projecting outward from bundle structures.
description: The areal density of exposed, broken, or terminated fiber tips visibly projecting outward from bundle structures.
scale_1: No visible exposed fiber tips or free ends; all strands are continuously looped or woven seamlessly through the field of view.
scale_5: A sparse to moderate presence of isolated projecting fiber terminations or stray broken ends.
scale_10: Abundant protruding fiber terminations and freely exposed ends densely bristling across the surface.
scoring_guide: 1: No visible exposed fiber tips or free ends; all strands are continuously looped or woven seamlessly through the field of view.; 5: A sparse to moderate presence of isolated projecting fiber terminations or stray broken ends.; 10: Abundant protruding fiber terminations and freely exposed ends densely bristling across the surface.

name: Sidewall Scalloping Prominence
definition: The degree of regular periodic undulation or ripple-like scalloping visible along the vertical sidewalls of etched or raised microstructures.
description: The degree of regular periodic undulation or ripple-like scalloping visible along the vertical sidewalls of etched or raised microstructures.
scale_1: Sidewalls are completely smooth and uniform with no visible horizontal ripple or scalloped ridges.
scale_5: Sidewalls show faint, moderately defined periodic horizontal ridges or scallops along sections of their depth.
scale_10: Sidewalls display prominent, sharply defined, continuous periodic scallops or deep ripple bands spanning their full vertical extent.
scoring_guide: 1: Sidewalls are completely smooth and uniform with no visible horizontal ripple or scalloped ridges.; 5: Sidewalls show faint, moderately defined periodic horizontal ridges or scallops along sections of their depth.; 10: Sidewalls display prominent, sharply defined, continuous periodic scallops or deep ripple bands spanning their full vertical extent.

name: Open-Loop Feature Curvature Openness
definition: The presence and degree of hook-like, C-shaped, or open re-entrant loop geometry in repeated microstructures.
description: The presence and degree of hook-like, C-shaped, or open re-entrant loop geometry in repeated microstructures.
scale_1: Features are solid, closed, or linear with zero re-entrant open-loop or C-shaped geometry.
scale_5: Features exhibit partial inward curving or notched profiles forming weak semi-enclosed cavities.
scale_10: Features consist entirely of pronounced, distinct C-shaped or hook-like open loops surrounding deep central cavities.
scoring_guide: 1: Features are solid, closed, or linear with zero re-entrant open-loop or C-shaped geometry.; 5: Features exhibit partial inward curving or notched profiles forming weak semi-enclosed cavities.; 10: Features consist entirely of pronounced, distinct C-shaped or hook-like open loops surrounding deep central cavities.

name: Isolated Point-Emitter Brightness Contrast
definition: The relative luminance contrast between isolated high-intensity point-like emission sites and an otherwise dark, low-signal background.
description: The relative luminance contrast between isolated high-intensity point-like emission sites and an otherwise dark, low-signal background.
scale_1: Uniform or gradually shaded field with no isolated, hyper-intense point emission sources against dark background.
scale_5: A few localized bright features present against a medium-gray background with moderate tonal contrast.
scale_10: Stark, extreme contrast consisting of pinpoint white emitter spots surrounded by a near-pitch-black zero-signal background.
scoring_guide: 1: Uniform or gradually shaded field with no isolated, hyper-intense point emission sources against dark background.; 5: A few localized bright features present against a medium-gray background with moderate tonal contrast.; 10: Stark, extreme contrast consisting of pinpoint white emitter spots surrounded by a near-pitch-black zero-signal background.

name: Inter-Ridge Tapering Gradient
definition: The rate at which elongated raised features narrow or taper along their longitudinal length.
description: The rate at which elongated raised features narrow or taper along their longitudinal length.
scale_1: Features maintain a strictly uniform, parallel cross-sectional width along their entire length without tapering.
scale_5: Features exhibit a gentle, moderate narrowing along their length from base to apex.
scale_10: Features exhibit severe, pronounced necking or acute linear tapering that drastically reduces their width over a short longitudinal distance.
scoring_guide: 1: Features maintain a strictly uniform, parallel cross-sectional width along their entire length without tapering.; 5: Features exhibit a gentle, moderate narrowing along their length from base to apex.; 10: Features exhibit severe, pronounced necking or acute linear tapering that drastically reduces their width over a short longitudinal distance.

name: Inter-Filament Entanglement Interlacing
definition: The degree to which individual continuous fibrous strands physically weave over and under adjacent strand bundles.
description: The degree to which individual continuous fibrous strands physically weave over and under adjacent strand bundles.
scale_1: No interlacing or over-under weaving; features are parallel, non-fibrous, or strictly disjoint.
scale_5: Moderate strand crossing where fiber bundles occasionally loop over adjacent groups.
scale_10: Pervasive 3D textile-like interlacing with continuous loop structures alternately passing over and under interlocking yarn bundles.
scoring_guide: 1: No interlacing or over-under weaving; features are parallel, non-fibrous, or strictly disjoint.; 5: Moderate strand crossing where fiber bundles occasionally loop over adjacent groups.; 10: Pervasive 3D textile-like interlacing with continuous loop structures alternately passing over and under interlocking yarn bundles.

name: Macroscopic Dark Stain Cloudiness
definition: The presence and areal extent of diffuse, low-contrast dark cloud-like shading artifacts or carbon contamination patches across the substrate.
description: The presence and areal extent of diffuse, low-contrast dark cloud-like shading artifacts or carbon contamination patches across the substrate.
scale_1: Uniform field brightness without large diffuse dark shaded patches or circular contamination halos.
scale_5: Local, faint diffuse dark shading patches covering a minor fraction of the frame.
scale_10: Prominent, large diffuse dark circular or cloud-like contamination stains heavily masking regional surface contrast.
scoring_guide: 1: Uniform field brightness without large diffuse dark shaded patches or circular contamination halos.; 5: Local, faint diffuse dark shading patches covering a minor fraction of the frame.; 10: Prominent, large diffuse dark circular or cloud-like contamination stains heavily masking regional surface contrast.

name: Irregular Boundary Etch Pit Cavity Area Fraction
definition: The fractional surface area occupied by deep, dark, irregularly shaped etch pits and hollow cavities etched into the matrix.
description: The fractional surface area occupied by deep, dark, irregularly shaped etch pits and hollow cavities etched into the matrix.
scale_1: Complete absence of deep irregular cavity depressions or etch voids.
scale_5: Scattered, localized irregular hollows and dark cavity pockets covering 5-10% of the surface.
scale_10: Extensive coalesced networks of deep, dark, tortuous etch cavities occupying >25% of the visible surface.
scoring_guide: 1: Complete absence of deep irregular cavity depressions or etch voids.; 5: Scattered, localized irregular hollows and dark cavity pockets covering 5-10% of the surface.; 10: Extensive coalesced networks of deep, dark, tortuous etch cavities occupying >25% of the visible surface.

name: Periodic Grating Spatial Frequency
definition: The visual line density or repetition count of parallel alternating bright/dark linear gratings per unit field of view.
description: The visual line density or repetition count of parallel alternating bright/dark linear gratings per unit field of view.
scale_1: Absence of periodic parallel linear grating striations.
scale_5: Moderately spaced parallel line arrays spanning across the field with intermediate cycle count.
scale_10: Extremely high spatial frequency grating consisting of tightly spaced, dense parallel striations filling the entire field.
scoring_guide: 1: Absence of periodic parallel linear grating striations.; 5: Moderately spaced parallel line arrays spanning across the field with intermediate cycle count.; 10: Extremely high spatial frequency grating consisting of tightly spaced, dense parallel striations filling the entire field.
